text: Tuma nde lepte ɗen memunooɓe, ɓe fewti kisan ka Muusaa (yo o his), ɓe wi'ani mo : "Ko an yo Muusaa, torano men Joomi maa sabu ko O hertiniran maa kon Annabaaku, e kon ko O ahodi e maaɗa ittugol lepte kala tuubuɗo nde O ittanta men ɗee lepte. Si a ittanii men ɗum, ma men gomɗine, men accide kadi e ɓiɗɓe Israa'iila ɓen.
